propositions: Extraction from free-text is heuristic and can select invalid decoys when schema-valid candidates exist outside the intended output region
Current markers (markdown fences, line breaks) are ambiguous and models fence-wrap quoted JSON, allowing decoys to win instead of the intended payload
An explicit line-anchored sentinel marker channel (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> and <<<END>>>) makes payload location a stated contract
The marker extraction must perform last-block-wins iteration in reverse document order, independent of the underlying selection pipeline's internal ordering
Markerless replies must fall through byte-for-byte identically to today's schema-filtered selection, preserving df3a-era transcript compatibility
Bounded-retry prompts must name the same markers as the first attempt, so the fail-closed retry channel remains consistent across both attempts
